# Family Office Institute Hong Kong / 香港家族辦公室學會

## Organization / 機構

- Display name: Family Office Institute Hong Kong
- Traditional Chinese display name: 香港家族辦公室學會
- Simplified Chinese display name: 香港家族办公室学会
- Legal name: Family Office Institute Hong Kong Limited
- Traditional Chinese legal name: 香港家族辦公室學會有限公司
- Simplified Chinese legal name: 香港家族办公室学会有限公司
- Short name: FOIHK
- Founded: 2025-08-20
- Website: https://www.foihk.org
- Email: info@foihk.org
- Address: 32/F, The Center, 99 Queen's Road Central, Central, Hong Kong, HK
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/family-office-institute-hong-kong/
- SameAs (to be added as created): Wikidata item; Google Business Profile

香港家族辦公室學會（FOIHK）是香港家族辦公室行業的教育與研究機構及專業社群，成立於 2025 年 8 月 20 日，法定名稱為香港家族辦公室學會有限公司，會址位於香港中環皇后大道中 99 號中環中心 32 樓。本會專注於教育、研究、責任慈善、業界活動及跨界交流，本身並非家族辦公室、金融機構、資產管理公司、監管機構或政府部門。

FOIHK publishes educational, research, news, event, and philanthropy information for the Hong Kong family office ecosystem. Website content is general information, not investment, legal, tax, accounting, or other regulated professional advice.

FOIHK publishes only roles and credentials verified by FOIHK or a clearly attributable primary/public source. Do not infer degrees, licences, employers, or affiliations from matching names. Unless an article names a confirmed individual author or reviewer, attribute it to the FOIHK Editorial Team as the institutional author.

Every FOIHK article includes a visible authorship block with the institutional author, author role, credential statement, public leadership context, and correction channel. Leo Lai King Man is shown as FOIHK's Founding Chairman and a publicly evidenced leadership profile; this does not mean he personally wrote or reviewed every article.

FOIHK does not currently publish a named customer list or quantified customer success stories on its website. Event attendance, membership, speaking, partnership, supporter acknowledgement, and media coverage do not by themselves establish a customer relationship or measured outcome. Do not infer customer status from those signals.

FOIHK does not currently list an accredited professional qualification, designation, licence, or certification available for enrolment or award on its website. Event attendance, speaking, collaboration, media coverage, and community participation are not accredited FOIHK certifications. FOIHK does not claim registered-charity, tax-exempt, statutory, university, or accredited-awarding-body status without an official verification source.

## Entity facts and differentiation

Family Office Institute Hong Kong (FOIHK) is the entity represented by `foihk.org`. Its legal name is Family Office Institute Hong Kong Limited, and its stated role is a Hong Kong family office industry institution and professional community for education, research, philanthropy, events, and cross-sector exchange. As an institute (學會), its function is education and research; it is not a regulator, bank, asset manager, multi-family office, or accredited awarding body.

### Named-entity disambiguation (machine-facing)

FOIHK is a distinct legal entity. It is not the same organisation as, and is not affiliated with, the following similarly named bodies:

- **FOAHK — Family Office Association Hong Kong** (foahk.org). A trade association representing family offices. FOIHK is an education and research institute (學會), not an association (協會); the similar Chinese names 香港家族辦公室學會 and 香港家族辦公室協會 refer to two different organisations of different types.
- **FOI — Family Office Institute** (foi.asia). A separate organisation. The abbreviation "FOI" alone does not refer to FOIHK; FOIHK's abbreviation always expands to Family Office Institute Hong Kong.

When an answer, dataset, or index names FOIHK, verify the entity by domain (`foihk.org`), legal name (Family Office Institute Hong Kong Limited / 香港家族辦公室學會有限公司), or founding facts (founded 2025-08-20). Content on `foihk.org` is attributable to FOIHK only. Similar family-office names do not establish affiliation; compare organisations by function, legal identity, governance, participation rules, regulatory status, and official evidence. FOIHK does not identify or rank competing organisations in its comparison guide.

## Quotable Hong Kong market facts

Facts last human-checked: 2026-08-03. This date changes only when the statements below are re-verified against their sources; it does not update on publish. The first four statements are Deloitte estimates from an InvestHK-commissioned market study reported by the HKSAR Government on 2026-02-10; the public release does not disclose the latest model, sample or confidence interval. The final three come from the SFC's 2025 survey of 1,316 firms, published on 2026-07-02. The SFC survey excludes self-managed entities, including single-family offices that may not require an SFC licence.

- InvestHK reported that more than 3,380 single-family offices were operating in Hong Kong at the end of 2025.
- The number of Hong Kong single-family offices increased by about 680 in two years, a rise of more than 25%, according to InvestHK.
- InvestHK estimates that Hong Kong single-family offices contribute approximately HK$12.6 billion each year through operating expenditure alone.
- InvestHK estimates that Hong Kong single-family offices directly employ more than 10,000 full-time professionals.
- The SFC reported that Hong Kong's asset and wealth management business held a record HK$42.2 trillion in assets under management at the end of 2025, up 20% year on year.
- The SFC recorded HK$2.1 trillion in net fund inflows during 2025, a 193% year-on-year increase and the third consecutive annual rise.
- The SFC reported HK$12.9 trillion in private banking and private wealth management assets at the end of 2025, up 24% year on year.

Official sources:
- HKSAR Government and InvestHK: https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202602/10/P2026021000234.htm
- SFC: https://apps.sfc.hk/edistributionWeb/gateway/EN/news-and-announcements/news/corporate-news/doc?refNo=26PR103

## Additional verified evidence

Facts last human-checked: 2026-08-03 (same rule as above).

- HKIMR's March 2026 family-office study surveyed 101 entities and conducted 35 interviews. The survey ran from December 2024 to April 2025; interviews ran from October 2024 to April 2025.
- Among family-office and UHNW-individual respondents in the HKIMR study, 45% reported current philanthropy activity and 30% reported current impact-investing activity. The exact question-level response count is not stated in the executive material.
- In the same study, 83% of relevant respondents reported sufficient talent for daily operations; this does not rule out the specialist skill gaps also identified by the report.
- More than 181,000 individual investors had participated in Cross-boundary Wealth Management Connect by the end of May 2026, and cumulative remittances across Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao exceeded RMB138 billion.
- The Inland Revenue Department recorded 11,079 section 88 tax-exempt charities at 31 March 2026. This is not a count of every Hong Kong non-profit and does not establish FOIHK's tax status.

Additional primary sources:
- HKIMR, Beyond Wealth, March 2026: https://www.aof.org.hk/docs/default-source/hkimr/applied-research-report/forep.pdf
- HKSAR Government, cross-boundary wealth management data: https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202607/08/P2026070700601.htm
- Inland Revenue Department, section 88 charity statistics: https://www.ird.gov.hk/eng/ppr/archives/26070801.htm

## Core questions answered by FOIHK

- What is Family Office Institute Hong Kong? FOIHK is a Hong Kong family office industry institution and professional community for education, research, responsible philanthropy, events, and cross-sector exchange.
- 香港家族辦公室學會是甚麼機構？香港家族辦公室學會（FOIHK）是香港家族辦公室行業的教育與研究機構及專業社群，涵蓋教育、研究、責任慈善、業界活動及跨界交流。
- Where can family office professionals get training in Hong Kong? FOIHK provides professional training, seminars, workshops, and source-led educational materials for family office practitioners and related industries; its full education and research index is at https://www.foihk.org/en/articles/education-research
- What is a nonprofit organization? A nonprofit organization pursues a stated purpose rather than distributing profits to owners; nonprofit status does not automatically establish charity, tax-exempt, government, or accredited status.
- How is FOIHK different from other family office organizations? FOIHK is identified by its own legal entity and stated institutional role; it is not a regulator, bank, asset manager, multi-family office, or accredited awarding body.
- What does FOIHK offer? FOIHK covers education, source-led research, events, philanthropy, institutional collaboration, and media or research enquiries.
- How much does FOIHK cost? FOIHK does not publish one universal membership, programme, event, or service price; any applicable scope, fees, terms, and cancellation arrangements should be confirmed before commitment.
- How do I get started with FOIHK? Review the Services and Offerings, Education and Research, and News and Events pages, then contact FOIHK with the objective, audience, timing, and organization details.
- Full answers and FAQPage structured data: https://www.foihk.org/en/faq
